Write the text of an Ujjwal Rail official circular (a notice that changes or adds to the rules).
Document: CIR-2026-09 "Cancellation charges from 2026-12-15" (effective from 2026-12-15). Language: English.
Write each section below as 1-4 clear sentences for passengers, using ONLY the facts given.
Keep every number, amount, percentage, time, date and document ID exactly as given, using Western
digits (0-9) even in Hindi. Write dates in the YYYY-MM-DD form given. Do not add any other numbers,
rules, phone numbers, websites or contact details.
Sections (name: facts):
- "1. Revised refund table": With effect from 2026-12-15 the flat cancellation charges are: Per confirmed or RAC passenger. More than 48 hours before departure: flat charge (SL Rs 100, 3A Rs 160, 2A Rs 200, 1A Rs 260, CC Rs 80). More than 12 and up to 48 hours: 25% of the fare, but not less than the flat charge. More than 4 and up to 12 hours: 50% of the fare, but not less than the flat charge. 4 hours or less before departure (after the chart): no refund. 'More than N hours' is strict: cancelling exactly N hours before departure falls in the next, costlier band.
Schema: {"sections": [{"section": "<exact section name>", "text": str}]}

sections.text: Effective from 2026-12-15, the flat cancellation charges per confirmed or RAC passenger are: SL Rs 100, 3A Rs 160, 2A Rs 200, 1A Rs 260, CC Rs 80 if you cancel more than 48 hours before departure. If you cancel more than 12 hours and up to 48 hours before departure, the charge will be 25% of the fare, but it will not be less than the flat charge mentioned above. If you cancel more than 4 hours and up to 12 hours before departure, the charge will be 50% of the fare, but it will not be less than the flat charge, and if you cancel 4 hours or less before departure (after the chart), no refund will be given. Note that "More than N hours" is strict, so cancelling exactly N hours before departure falls in the next, costlier band.
